loadError.title: Documents did not load
loadError.text: Could not get the data. Please try again.

unavailable.title: Document flow is not responding
unavailable.text: The documents service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing is lost — try again shortly.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: The "For approval" section is not available to your role.

notGranted.title: No access to document flow
notGranted.text: Your account has not been added to document flow yet. Write to the administrator.

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.text: There is no such document, it was not sent for approval, or your role cannot see it.

list.subtitle: Memos, applications and reports awaiting approval.
list.caption: Documents for approval
list.select: Show document {{number}} in the side panel

mine.title: Nothing on your step
mine.text: Memos and other documents with an approval route will appear here.

all.title: No approvals yet
all.text: Documents you sent or approve will appear here.

card.title: {{number}}
card.readOnlyHint: The approver makes the decision. You see the document read-only.

readOnly.title: Document awaits approval
readOnly.text: The approver makes the decision. You see the document read-only.
readOnly.notYourStep: It is another approver's step now. You can decide when it is your turn.

approved.title: Document approved
approved.text: The decision is made. The author was notified; the document stays in the registry with your visa and date.

returned.title: Document returned for rework
returned.text: The author will fix it and send the document again.

rejected.title: Document rejected
rejected.text: The decision is made and closed. The author received the comment.

form.name: Document approval

comment.label: Comment
comment.hint: Required to return for rework or reject; optional for approval.

consequence.title: What will happen
consequence.step2: The author gets a notification with your comment.
consequence.step3: The document stays in the registry with your visa, date and comment.

form.disabled: You can return or reject only with a comment: the buttons are inactive while it is empty.

reasons.route_closed: the document was already decided by another approver, the card is refreshed
reasons.checklist_not_green: the approval conditions are not met, the card is refreshed
reasons.checklist_not_green_plain: the approval conditions are not met, the card is refreshed
reasons.not_your_step: it is not your step now
reasons.eds_not_granted: you are not added to document flow
reasons.forbidden: the action is not available to your role
reasons.unavailable: the documents service is not responding, the comment stays in the form
reasons.unknown: something went wrong, the comment stays in the form
